nat_note: A storm's pushes carry the data its sandboxes wrote (fresh_bytes: size x mb MiB of random bytes, which do not compress) plus the transfer's overhead. ECR's image sizes (snapshot_bytes) also count each image's base layers, which the registry already holds, so a push skips them. Resumes pull from S3 through the VPC's gateway endpoint, not the NAT gateway; the VPC has no ECR endpoint. A storm's bytes show in the one-minute point after the one its pause window falls in (the NAT gateway's own timing; the window is padded by one point on each side for that reason).
